items.title: Oil Price Rally Helps Energy Stocks, Hurts Airlines
items.summary: The 5% jump in U.S. crude oil prices today is having some of the familiar effects we've seen in recent months across the market when tensions build in the Middle East.    Winners largely are coming from the energy sector, which is the best performing group in the S&P 500 today.
